overview: Seoul's palaces, theme parks and K-culture, plus volcanic Jeju island. Clean, safe and very modern with excellent public transport.
fit: Great for both: Lotte World, Everland, aquariums and Jeju's beaches.
season: April–May (spring flowers) and September–November (autumn colours) are best. July–August is hot and rainy; December–February is freezing (-10°C).
gettingAround: Seoul subway with a T-money card; car or taxis on Jeju.

todo.title: Lotte World
todo.why: Huge indoor and outdoor theme park

todo.title: Jeju Hello Kitty Island / Teddy Bear Museum

stay.why: Near the airport or the south coast

food.name: Bibimbap
food.note: Mixed rice bowl; ask for no meat

foodTips: Vegetarian is challenging; use temple food restaurants and Itaewon.
save: Travel in May or October shoulder weeks
Use Discover Seoul Pass if you'll visit many attractions
Fly to Jeju on low-cost carriers
safety: Winter cold is harsh; dress warmly
Use crossings carefully; cars turn on red
health: Fine dust days in spring: masks
visa: Indian passport holders need a South Korean tourist visa (sticker visa) via the Korea Visa Application Centre; apply 4–6 weeks ahead with bank statements and ITRs.
